issue: PA/BM counter displayed 0/5 but first download could jump directly to 2/5.
root_cause: JavaScript/backend fallback expressions used logical OR for downloadCount, so explicit numeric 0 was treated as missing and could fall through to stale legacy usedCount/downloadsUsed (for example 1).
Repeated paid/payment verification sync could previously reset only downloadCount to 0 on an existing record while a legacy alias still held 1, creating an inconsistent 0/1 state.
fixes: Use nullish/explicit zero-safe resolution where PA/BM download count is read.
Do not reset an existing PA/BM downloadCount during repeated paid verification in the active deploy backend.
Use the same zero-safe count in Admin, Latest Purchase List and My Purchases related code.
Bump frontend auth/live-sync bundle cache-busters to 1109.
